payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on the methods used for data collection, specifically mentioning the use of the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower and the manual collection of templates and keywords from user interactions.

claims.text: Data was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower.
Templates and keywords were manually collected from frequent expressions used by CF workers during the dataset collection process.
The dataset consists of 1900 dialogs collected from interactions on the platform.
